Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.
Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.
Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction , and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy Based in Europe's film on how we're fixing Europe's housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

Hiring well is the single biggest thing that decides how fast Monumental can go, and the top of our funnel is where we most need horsepower.
This is a role for someone near the start of their career who wants to learn to hire well, fast. You'll work alongside Dom and the recruiting team as a junior recruiter - the person who finds candidates, reads their CVs, and runs the first call that decides who moves forward. It's high-volume, high-judgment work: you'll interact with most of the people who enter our process, and the quality of what you pass up decides the status of our pipelines.
To be clear about what this looks like day to day: you'll start with our highest-volume hiring, robot operators and technicians for our workshop and construction sites, and this is where most of your time will go, especially in your first months.

Some of the work is unglamorous, and we won't pretend otherwise: expect lots of first-stage interviewing, chasing down leads, and doing what's needed to grow a high-performing team. It's also some of the highest-leverage work in the company.

When our hiring engine runs smoothly, we have more hands free to build robots and brick walls on construction sites for our customers. As you build the instinct for it, you'll take on more of our hiring across the company over time.
You'll get real ownership of the top of the funnel from the start, close support from people who are excellent at this, and a clear path to owning full searches as you grow. Get good at this and you'll become a recruiter who can be handed any role, however unusual, and fill it well.

You'll own the top of our hiring funnel, plus whatever else the team needs a hand with.
Sourcing. Find candidates for the roles you're driving, mostly our field and operator hiring, across job boards, LinkedIn, referrals and inbound ad responses, and build strong shortlists worth the hiring manager's time.
CV and application screens. Read candidates against what "great" actually looks like for each role, not just a keyword match. You'll calibrate your judgment fast by doing this at volume.
First calls. Qualify candidates, get them excited about Monumental, and make an accurate first read on whether they clear the bar. This is the part that matters most, and the part you'll get better at fastest.
Keep the pipeline moving. Schedule interviews, keep Ashby clean and up to date, and make sure no candidate goes cold or waits on us. A fast, tight process is a competitive advantage and you own it.
Candidate experience. Give every candidate a fast, respectful experience whether they move forward or not. People remember how they were treated.
Recruiting events. Help plan and run a recruiting or team event every couple of months, a fun way to bring candidates and the team together and mix up the week.
Where it leads. The growth here is more judgment and autonomy, not just a longer to-do list. You start at the top of the funnel; soon you're running full searches end to end and making the call on who clears the bar.

High energy, intrinsic curiosity, and hungry to get very good at hiring. This is the single most important thing. You want to become an excellent recruiter, and you run at feedback rather than away from it.
Near the start of your career - a recent graduate with strong internship experience, or up to a few years of full-time work in recruiting, sourcing, ops, or a role where you had to find things out and get things done with little hand-holding. We care more about raw ability and drive than a specific background.
A genuinely good judge of people, with high standards. You're curious about what makes someone tick and whether they'd be great here, you'd rather send three strong candidates than ten mediocre ones, and you're starting to be able to tell the difference.
Sharp, organised and completely reliable. You keep a lot of candidates and threads moving without dropping any, and people can trust that what you said you'd do gets done.
Strong written and verbal communication. Your messages are clear and human, and you're comfortable on a first call with a stranger, whether that's a technician on a building site or a robotics engineer.
Genuine interest in technology. You don't need to be technical, but you're curious about what our engineers and operators build and why it matters.
Ownership and comfort with ambiguity. We're scaling fast and priorities shift; you figure out what needs doing and do it rather than wait to be told.
Nice to have: some recruiting or sourcing experience, in-house or agency; experience with high-volume or blue-collar hiring; familiarity with Ashby or another ATS; time at a fast-growing startup or scale-up; Dutch language skills, which are genuinely useful given our field hiring but not a hard requirement.
Why Monumental?
Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.
For open applications (where you don't see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: iwanttojoin@monumental.co - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you've worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio.
Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.
If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and back yourself to learn fast and have great judgment about people, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

About Pleo
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high.

With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our Talent Acquisition team at Pleo. In this role, you'll manage high-volume, mid-to-senior hiring across the organisation, partnering with teams across Tech, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Product and other functions.
You'll own multiple searches at once and play a key role in building strong, proactive talent pipelines that keep our hiring moving. You'll bring structure, pace and consistency to the recruitment process, using repeatable and scalable approaches while still creating a thoughtful experience for every candidate.
If you're someone who loves being organised, thrives when managing multiple priorities, enjoys proactive sourcing and gets satisfaction from turning complex hiring needs into well-run recruitment processes, we'd love to meet you.
Who you’ll be working with and reporting to
You’ll report to our Head of Talent Acquisition and work closely with hiring managers and stakeholders across Pleo, including senior leaders and functional teams across various business areas.
You'll be part of a collaborative team that values high-quality delivery, strong partnership and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with the wider People team and cross-functional partners to make sure our hiring processes are efficient, consistent and deliver a great experience for candidates and hiring teams.
What you’ll be doing

s.h: As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will
s.t:
Own full-cycle recruitment across a high volume of mid-to-senior roles, managing multiple requisitions simultaneously across different functions.
Build proactive talent pipelines through sourcing, market mapping, talent research, referrals and personalised outreach - rather than relying on inbound applications alone.
Develop and use repeatable sourcing and recruitment processes that enable us to hire efficiently and consistently at scale.
Partner closely with hiring managers to understand requirements, agree hiring plans and keep searches moving from briefing through to offer.
Manage a busy recruitment workload with excellent organisation, prioritisation and attention to detail, ensuring no candidate or stakeholder falls through the cracks.
Create engaging, personalised outreach that gets the attention of passive candidates and builds interest in Pleo.
Use recruitment data and dashboards to track pipelines, identify bottlenecks and understand where searches need more focus.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment data and processes in tools such as Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Notion and Google Sheets.
Use emerging AI and recruitment technology, including tools such as Claude, to improve research, sourcing, workflows and overall recruitment effectiveness.
Support effective and consistent technical hiring processes, including the use of tools such as CoderPad for assessments where relevant.
Champion inclusive hiring practices and ensure consistency and fairness throughout the recruitment process.

s.h: You’ll thrive in this role if you have
s.t:
Proven experience managing a high volume of mid-to-senior recruitment requisitions simultaneously, ideally across multiple functions.
Strong proactive sourcing skills, with a track record of building talent pipelines from scratch and engaging passive candidates.
A highly organised and structured approach to recruitment. You naturally keep track of multiple searches, candidates, stakeholders, interviews and next steps without losing attention to detail.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with hiring managers while keeping them accountable to the recruitment process.
Excellent communication skills and a candidate-first mindset, with the ability to create a great experience even when managing a high volume of candidates.
A data-led approach to recruitment and confidence using metrics to monitor pipeline health, identify challenges and improve hiring outcomes.
An interest in using AI and emerging technology to make recruitment more efficient, effective and scalable.
Experience working in a fast-paced and scaling environment.

s.h: Experience using tools such as Ashby and Claude (preferred).
s.t: Why is this role a good fit for you

s.h: This role is a good fit for you if
s.t:
You enjoy managing lots of moving parts and get satisfaction from keeping complex recruitment processes organised and on track.
You're a proactive sourcer who enjoys finding great people who aren't actively looking and figuring out how to get them excited about Pleo.
You like having a clear process, but you're also constantly looking for ways to make it more efficient, scalable and effective.
You enjoy variety and want to recruit across different functions rather than specialising in one talent market.
You thrive in a fast-paced environment where you'll have a meaningful number of roles to own and plenty of opportunity to make an impact.

s.h: This role is not a good fit for you if
s.t:
You prefer working on a small number of highly specialised or executive searches at a time.
You rely primarily on inbound applications and aren't energised by proactive sourcing and pipeline building.
You find managing multiple concurrent requisitions and competing priorities challenging.
You prefer an environment where every search is highly bespoke rather than one where repeatable, scalable processes are important.
How you’ll develop in this role

s.h: In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll have the opportunity to
s.t:
Broaden your recruitment expertise by hiring across a range of functions, seniority levels and talent markets, building a more rounded understanding of how different parts of a scaling business hire.
Sharpen your sourcing craft by developing stronger market-mapping, research and outreach skills, and learning how to build talent pipelines in increasingly targeted and creative ways.
Build stronger commercial and business partnering skills by working directly with hiring managers and senior stakeholders, developing your ability to understand business needs and influence hiring decisions.
Become more data-driven in your approach by using recruitment data to assess pipeline health, diagnose challenges and make better decisions about where to focus your time and effort.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them.
The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time.
The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both.

· Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships and Customer Success.

· Build a sharp point of view on the UK market and future expansion markets: the companies producing strong talent, the people who outperform their peers and the communities that matter.

· Use research, data and AI as part of your everyday craft to identify and qualify exceptional candidates. We expect a written market point of view, not just a slate of profiles.

· Run thoughtful, personalised outreach grounded in the candidate's actual background, commercial motion or recent work. We care more about quality, replies and conversion than send volume.

· Partner with GTM leaders to turn ambitious hiring plans into a clear profile, credible process and realistic compensation strategy. Surface hard market truth early and push back constructively when needed.

· Own the candidate experience from first conversation through offer close: fast follow-up, clear communication, strong process discipline and a tailored closing plan for the candidates we most want.

· Build real presence for Ramp in London through the right relationships, referrals and targeted community activity. The point is pipeline and credibility, not events for their own sake.

· Work tightly with the wider GTM Recruiting team on calibration, sourcing support, insight and operating rhythm, while bringing strong local judgment.

· Help improve how Ramp recruits for expansion by capturing what works in the UK and applying it thoughtfully as we enter new markets.
What You Need

· 5+ years of full-cycle GTM or Sales recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology company where quality and pace both mattered.

· Strong knowledge of the UK technology talent market and a credible local network, or clear evidence that you can build one quickly.

· A track record of finding and closing exceptional people, not simply running inherited processes. You can point to candidates you identified who became strong hires.

· Excellent sourcing and research instincts. You can explain why someone is genuinely differentiated, not only that they have the right title at the right company.

· Experience hiring across several GTM functions, such as AEs, Sales Leadership, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships, Customer Success or RevOps.

· Strong candidate-closing judgment. You listen closely, understand what each candidate is weighing and can build conviction against serious alternatives.

· The confidence to influence senior leaders, challenge a mis-scoped search and make a hiring process better without creating unnecessary friction.

· Comfort using data to understand funnel health, diagnose problems and hold an honest conversation about what needs to change.

· High ownership. You book the next step while you have the candidate, chase what is stuck and do not wait for a detailed brief to get useful work moving.

· Specific, sharp written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should never feel template-driven.

· Experience recruiting for a fintech, SaaS, infrastructure or similarly complex B2B product.

· Experience joining a company as the first recruiter in a new geography, or helping to scale an international business.

· Experience building an AI-augmented recruiting research workflow.
Why this Role
You will have unusual ownership over one of Ramp's most important growth priorities, with the support of an established Talent team rather than the isolation of a one-person recruiting function. The work is practical and high impact: build the UK commercial team, help leaders make better hiring decisions and raise the bar for how Ramp recruits as it enters new markets.

If you’re a recruiter who wants comfort, predictability, and guardrails—this probably isn’t it.
If you want ownership, influence, swagger, and impact—welcome to Axon.
Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors.

Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers .

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.
We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion.

We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work.

If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com. Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

As a member of our Global Talent Acquisition team you will be charged with full-life cycle recruitment efforts targeting experienced candidates who align to the mission of the Axon organization: a sense of determination, recruiting prowess, and a desire to make an impact on the world.

You're responsible for guiding both candidates and hiring teams through our hiring process. You are focused and driven, with an interpersonal savvy that allows you to partner effectively with candidates, hiring business partners, peers and executives.

We are a scrappy bunch and recruiting is a team sport at Axon, so we expect our team to dive in to support one another and our exciting goals.
This role is based out of our Seattle office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Reports to: Manager, Talent Acquisition
Manage full life cycle recruitment processes from sourcing to offer stage for our hiring teams across the business.
Support hiring business partners with recruiting strategies to fill current needs while also developing a programmatic framework for pipelining talent for future needs.
Upkeep and review data and reporting to provide impactful data insights that identify trends and influence decision making for recruitment strategies.
Utilize Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse (Axon’s applicant tracking system) and other creative sourcing techniques to identify candidates and create a robust pipeline.
Measure outputs and iterate to ensure continuous improvement, championing new recruitment/sourcing/posting ideas, to include software tools.
Create a positive candidate experience; reinforce exceptional standards and provide timely feedback and follow up status for both internal/external candidates throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Develop and cultivate rapport with hiring business leaders, talent acquisition, and peers; understand business objectives and translate these to talent needs and candidate profiles.
Drive and execute on DEI search strategies by proactively sourcing diverse talent, fostering an inclusive recruitment process, and partnering with hiring managers to build teams that reflect a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.
Implement effective diversity pipeline generation and engagement strategies.
Manage and prioritize multiple unique searches concurrently.

Bachelor's degree; equivalent years of demonstrated experience will also be considered
Minimum of 5 years of experience as a full-cycle Recruiter; combination of agency and corporate recruiting experience a plus
Demonstrated experience sourcing, recruiting and building strong candidate talent pipelines
Previous experience managing high volume requisitions both exempt and non-exempt level roles
Ability to deliver results and thrive in a fast paced environment and effectively manage and prioritize multiple projects and candidates
Decisive and able to influence others to drive results and create impact
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to network within the industry to identify top performers
A genuine passion for DEI and inclusivity by championing equity in all stages of the hiring lifecycle.
Superb customer service focus, attention to detail and organization skills

30 days paid time off
Company and performance bonus scheme
Paid extended parental leave for all
Private Health Insurance
Fitness Programs
Emotional & Mental Wellness support
Learning & Development programs
And yes, we have snacks in our offices
Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
We are seeking a high-potential Recruiter to help build and scale our APAC & Japan team. In this role, you will design and execute customized sourcing strategies, manage end-to-end recruitment pipelines, and serve as a trusted partner to local hiring managers for all talent acquisition needs.

End-to-End Talent Acquisition: Source, recruit, and hire top talent across our Japan teams — mainly GTM, but also spanning Technical roles and G&A — managing the candidate lifecycle from initial outreach to offer acceptance.
Hiring Manager Partnership: Collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand team priorities, define ideal candidate profiles, and implement best-in-class recruiting strategies.
Candidate Evaluation & Debriefs: Screen candidates, facilitate post-interview debrief sessions, and guide hiring teams toward making data-driven hiring decisions.
Pipeline Management & Market Insights: Maintain a strong pulse on SaaS/Tech hiring trends in Japan, leveraging both direct sourcing methods and agency relationships to build robust, scalable candidate talent pools.
Broader Impact: Opportunities to support regional APAC recruiting initiatives and participate in cross-functional HR projects beyond talent acquisition in the future.

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of full-lifecycle recruiting experience (agency or in-house).
Bilingual Capability: Fluency in Japanese (native-level or equivalent) and professional working proficiency in English to engage with local candidates and communicate with global stakeholders.
Growth Mindset & Curiosity: Eager to learn, open to feedback, and willing to try new approaches as the recruitment market evolves.
Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Ability to track and analyze recruiting metrics to resolve pipeline bottlenecks and contribute to broader recruitment strategies.
Execution & Organization: Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a proven ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Stakeholder Management: Experience engaging with or supporting senior leadership is highly preferred. (does not need to be limited to recruiting contexts)

Experience using Greenhouse ATS or similar modern recruiting platforms.
Experience recruiting within the SaaS / Cloud / Enterprise Technology industry.

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging.™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses.

Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement.

From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.
Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News & World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

We’re looking for an enthusiastic Senior Recruitment Coordinator to be an integral part of the Talent Team! You will be involved in many aspects of the recruitment process, ranging from communicating with candidates, partnering with recruiters and hiring managers, and driving process improvements across the team.

Support a team of R&D recruiters with day-to-day scheduling of engineering and technical interviews across multiple teams and timezones
Manage candidate communications and deliver a high-quality candidate experience to every candidate
Ensure all recruitment activities are accurately tracked and own the creation of new job postings
Have a strong understanding of the ATS to drive data hygiene efforts
Demonstrates independence when managing individual responsibilities
Partner with the Talent Team on process improvements

2-3 years of professional experience in recruitment coordination or similar recruiting-related role
Ability to independently problem solve in a fast-paced environment and manage your time effectively
Experience with at least one applicant tracking system, ideally Greenhouse
Proficient with Google Applications (Gmail, Calendar and Drive). Experience with GoodTime scheduling is a major plus
Detail oriented with strong organizational skills
Strong written and verbal communication
Takes initiative to identify inefficiencies and provide strategic solutions
Strong team player who demonstrates interest and ability in contributing to the recruiting team success
For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $59,000 and $84,000/year with an expected On Target Earnings ( OTE ) between $65,000 and $93,000/year (including bonus or commission).

Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

We’re looking for a world class Senior Technical Recruiter to help build and scale our PDE (Product, Design, and Engineering) teams. This person should be excited to design and execute customized recruiting strategies while also being a Talent Partner - a point person for all things hiring with our hiring managers. In addition to this, they should also expect to:
Manage high-volume, high impact searches with minimal guidance, demonstrating creativity in problem-solving and resourcefulness across all stages of the hiring journey
Develop and execute creative recruitment strategies by leveraging data from tools like Greenhouse, Gem, and Looker to improve our practices
Serve as a strategic partner to your stakeholders by facilitating dialogue
Identify and share innovative sourcing techniques to elevate your searches
Act as a thought partner to your hiring managers across all organizational levels, including executive leadership and key cross-functional stakeholders
Maintain a stellar candidate experience at every stage, ensuring each technical candidate feels respected, valued, and well-informed
Drive new and impactful operational processes within the TA team, embracing a solution-oriented and growth mindset to solve complex scenarios
Act as a Change Agent, effectively communicating the rationale behind new processes and enabling and encouraging others to adapt to them
Seamlessly work across departments, offering support to other teams during hiring spikes
Mentor and guide more junior team members, leading by example and fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace

Minimum of 5 years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience in a dynamic, fast-paced tech environment, ideally with a high-growth startup
Successful track record of hiring technical talent, with experience across skillsets including software engineering, product management, and design
Deep understanding of recruitment metrics and the ability to use data effectively to drive strategic decisions
Proven experience in independently partnering with and influencing executive leadership on hiring initiatives
Strong knowledge and interest in technology and engineering

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. Recruiting at Brex
Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams.

We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in creating a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the very first contact. We don’t just fill roles, we shape the culture at Brex, finding the next generation of builders and leaders.

As a Senior Technical Sourcer, you will be a strategic talent partner responsible for identifying, engaging, and building pipelines of world-class technical talent. You’ll collaborate closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and technical leaders to deeply understand role requirements and develop proactive sourcing strategies that fuel both immediate hiring needs and long-term growth.
You’ll leverage advanced sourcing techniques, data insights, and market mapping to uncover exceptional talent across engineering, data, product, AI, and emerging technical domains. This role requires creativity, persistence, and strong business acumen to engage passive candidates and position Brex as an employer of choice. You’ll also play a key role in strengthening our diversity sourcing strategies and continuously improving sourcing processes and tools.
Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Lead end-to-end sourcing strategies for technical roles across engineering, data, product, AI, and other specialized functions.
Conduct market research, competitive intelligence, and talent mapping to inform hiring strategies and pipeline development.
Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through creative outreach across platforms such as LinkedIn, GitHub, and other talent networks.
Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to align on candidate profiles, calibrate talent, and refine search strategies.
Build and nurture long-term talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill roles, including future-facing skill sets.
Champion diversity sourcing initiatives to attract underrepresented technical talent.
Track, analyze, and report on sourcing metrics to continuously optimize outreach effectiveness and pipeline health.
Maintain accurate candidate data and activity tracking within recruiting systems and dashboards.
Contribute to process improvements, sourcing best practices, and knowledge sharing within the recruiting team.

3+ years of experience sourcing for technical roles (e.g., software engineering, infrastructure, data, product, AI) in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Demonstrated expertise in advanced sourcing techniques, Boolean search, talent mapping, and market research.
Strong understanding of technical skill sets, engineering org structures, and emerging technology trends.
Proven ability to engage and convert passive candidates through thoughtful, personalized outreach.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build trust with technical leaders.
Data-driven mindset with experience using sourcing metrics to refine strategy and improve results.
Ability to manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

Experience sourcing for AI/ML, agentic AI, or other emerging technical domains.
Experience recruiting or sourcing across multiple geographies (e.g., US, Canada, LATAM).
Familiarity with tools such as Gem, Greenhouse, or other modern sourcing and CRM platforms.
Experience contributing to employer branding, talent marketing, or community-building initiatives.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes.

We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Talent Acquisition team at Celonis is a global function at the heart of our growth. We go beyond recruiting to act as trusted talent advisors and candidate experience champions, driving strategies that bring future leaders into the business.
We are now looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner with a background hiring technical customer facing roles for a technology company. This position offers the chance to directly influence our success, in a fast-scaling, international environment.

As a trusted partner to our Customer organizations, you will be responsible for overseeing and guiding both hiring managers and candidates through the full life-cycle recruitment process.You will be a strategic advisor to our leaders, bringing not only recruiting expertise but also actionable talent insights that influence hiring decisions and shape our overall talent strategy.
You will act as the trusted partner to our hiring leaders and the main point of contact for our candidates throughout the recruitment journey. Leveraging your background in hiring top technical talent you will bring credibility and market expertise to every search.
Celonis is the market leader in Process Intelligence , and our TA team embraces this innovation daily. With our technology embedded in our ATS, you’ll have access to real-time data and advanced reporting tools that sharpen your ability to advise, plan, and execute.

Partner with our regional hiring managers to understand their hiring needs and job requirements, offering strategic advice and support throughout the recruitment process.
Work closely with the HR team and Compensation & Benefits team and other internal stakeholders to align recruitment efforts with company goals and processes.

Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and extending offers to candidates for Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, Services, PreSales and Value Engineering roles.
Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top talent, utilizing various channels such as job boards, social media, networking events, and referrals.

Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process by providing timely feedback and communication.
Work hand in hand with Talent Coordination to schedule interviews, providing necessary support and resources to both candidates and hiring managers.

Stay up-to-date with industry trends, competitor activity, and market conditions to effectively position Celonis as an employer of choice.
Provide market intelligence and insights to hiring managers to aid in decision-making and strategy development.

Track and analyze recruitment metrics to measure the effectiveness of recruiting strategies and processes
Provide regular updates and reports to management on recruitment activities, challenges, and successes.
Leverage our ATS and Sourcing Tools to ensure excellence and efficiencies are adopted in our working practices

A background recruiting technical customer facing roles, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for finding and hiring the best talent.
Strong understanding of technology and industry trends.
End to end recruitment experience from Sourcing to Offer Management
Inhouse, agency or RPO recruitment experience hiring for Product , Technology or IT Services businesses.
Proficiency in applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools.
Excellent communication skills and interest in interacting with colleagues, candidates and partners.
You can come as you are – the fun-loving, passionate seller, who never gets shy of pushing boundaries or asking the tough questions with stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize workload.
Strong sourcing and candidate outreach capabilities

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.

The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity.

Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.
We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company .

As a contract G&A and Operations Recruiter, you will find top-tier candidates who bring strong ability, an entrepreneurial spirit, a strong sense of ownership, and diversity of thought. You will be responsible for communicating the Checkr story and value proposition while sourcing and guiding candidates through our hiring process. You are driven, eager, and able to develop lasting relationships with both candidates and hiring managers.
This is a 6-month contract position.

Collaborate with hiring managers and executives to understand hiring needs and define requirements
Develop unique sourcing strategies to surface top passive candidates
Review resumes, pre-screen candidates, and drive the interview process from end to end
Organize and facilitate interview debriefs, helping to guide and drive decision making
Own the offer approval, extension and negotiation process, and effectively close prospective candidates
Create and maintain an amazing candidate experience

6+ years of in-house recruiting experience hiring G&A and Operations talent at a tech company.

Strong sourcing ability and a diverse bag of tricks
Passion for creating an elite candidate experience
Great written and verbal communication skills
Ability to develop strong relationships with candidates and hiring managers
Time management and multitasking skills
A sense of ownership and accountability for the roles you own
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website .

A fast-paced and collaborative environment
Learning and development allowance
Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. In this role, you’ll partner closely with recruiters and engineering leaders to develop thoughtful sourcing strategies and engage hard-to-find talent at every level, from individual contributors to senior leadership. Experience identifying and engaging niche technical talent across all levels, from individual contributors to senior leadership
Experience partnering with recruiters and hiring managers to develop sourcing strategies and influence search direction

Curiosity about emerging recruiting technologies, including experience experimenting with AI recruiting tools

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations
Singapore

Cloudflare is looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to be a cornerstone of our hiring engine in Austin, Texas. This isn't just about managing calendars; you'll be a key player in bringing structure to our hiring efforts, ensuring an exceptional global candidate experience, and supporting the high-quality hiring decisions that drive our mission forward.
If you're someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting, possesses a keen eye for detail, and is dedicated to delivering positive experiences, we want to hear from you. You'll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers, ensuring every candidate interaction truly reflects Cloudflare's best.

This is a fantastic opportunity to launch or pivot into a career in Talent Acquisition, where your organizational skills and candidate-centric approach will directly influence our ability to attract top talent and shape their perception of Cloudflare.

Manage interview logistics across various formats (video, phone, and in-person) with precision and efficiency, ensuring a seamless experience for all participants.
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, both virtually and in-person, demonstrating empathy and a customer/candidate-oriented approach.
Utilize applicant tracking system, scheduling tools, dashboards, and candidate trackers to ensure accuracy and maximize efficiency for Cloudflare’s Interview Experience program.
Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism.
Communicate clearly, directly, and transparently with candidates, recruiters, and internal stakeholders
Partner with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to streamline processes and contribute to cross-functional recruiting operations projects and improvements.
Actively identify opportunities for process enhancements and suggesting solutions, as well as supporting program initiatives where bandwidth allows.
Collaborate with and provide mutual support to team members on shared tasks and challenges.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
Experience in a fast-paced environment where exceptional organizational skills , high-volume coordination , or extensive client/customer support were essential.
Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively.
Maintain meticulous attention to detail, even under pressure.
Consistently meet deadlines and service standards.
A resourceful and proactive approach to identifying and resolving routine challenges independently.
Quick to learn and adapt to ambiguous or changing situations.
View mistakes as opportunities for growth.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Able to engage professionally and empathetically with diverse stakeholders.
Possess a strong collaborative spirit.
Build positive professional relationships and contribute to a supportive team environment.
A genuine passion for delivering positive experiences.
Lead with empathy and assume good intentions in all interactions.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law.

We're looking for a Recruiter to be the driving force behind hiring the technical talent that powers our go-to-market engine across Singapore (Asean/Greater China Region) — Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the broader Field Engineering org.

These are the people who sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers, turn the world's hardest data and AI problems into production reality, and make Databricks impossible to compete against. Your job is to find them, win them, and close them.
This is an exciting time to be part of the rocketship and the Databricks expansion in India. We're scaling fast, the bar is high, and the demand for elite technical pre-sales and field talent has never been more intense. You'll own full-cycle hiring for some of the most sought-after profiles in the market, partnering directly with Field Engineering leadership to build teams that don't yet exist.
Recruiters at Databricks are subject matter experts when it comes to talent attraction and are given full autonomy to bring new ideas and creative approaches to life. If you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and get energy from building in a high-growth, high-pressure environment, read on.

Own full-cycle recruiting for technical GTM roles across Singapore (Asean/Greater China Region) — Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Field Engineering leadership — from first outreach to close.
Partner with Field Engineering and Sales leaders as a true strategic advisor on sourcing strategy, market mapping, competitive intelligence, comp positioning, and talent insights.
Activate and engage passive, hard-to-reach technical talent — the builders and problem-solvers who aren't actively looking but are exactly who we need.
Build and sustain engaged talent pipelines that can keep pace with aggressive hiring goals and our continued APJ expansion.
Create closing strategies that win against the most competitive offers in the market and manage stakeholder expectations with data.
Use data to set benchmarks and metrics, drive workforce planning, and continuously sharpen our hiring process as we scale.
Champion a world-class candidate experience and act as a brand ambassador for Databricks at every touchpoint.
Play a key role in building a diverse, inclusive, and exceptionally high-caliber workforce.

Proven experience recruiting within the software / Data / AI industry, ideally for technical GTM, pre-sales, Solutions Architecture, or Field Engineering profiles.
A track record of scaling teams at a high-growth company — you know what it takes to hire fast without dropping the bar.
High energy, grit, and a relentless work ethic — you get stuff done and you don't wait to be told how.
An "AI builder" mindset: genuinely curious about the technology, hands-on with new tools, and able to speak credibly to deeply technical candidates.
Comfort with chaos — you stay calm, prioritize ruthlessly, and thrive when the goalposts move and the pressure is on.
The ability to build strategic partnerships across the business and influence senior stakeholders with data and conviction.
A creative, resourceful approach to sourcing — you don't rely on the obvious channels and you love finding talent others can't.
Strong ownership and a bias for action; you treat your reqs like they're your own business.

Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

We're looking for a Recruiter to join our EMEA Talent Acquisition team, supporting hiring across Field Engineering and GTM. This is a sourcing-led role: you will spend the majority of your time in the market — mapping talent, running outbound campaigns, and building relationships with passive candidates long before we have a role to fill.

You will own full-cycle hiring for our early career and individual contributor roles, and partner with senior recruiters on more complex searches. You will report directly to the Manager, EMEA Talent Acquisition.

This is a strong fit if you want to build deep technical sourcing skills in the Data and AI space and grow into a senior, business-facing recruiting career.
The impact you will have
Own full-cycle hiring for entry to mid-level Field Engineering roles across EMEA — Associate and mid-level Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, Delivery Solutions Architects, and similar.
Run creative, high-quality outbound sourcing: build target lists, write outreach that people actually reply to, and keep a healthy pipeline of engaged passive candidates.
Build market maps and talent pools by market, skill and competitor, and keep them warm so we can move quickly when headcount opens.
Partner with hiring managers and senior recruiters on intake, calibration and candidate feedback, and keep them informed with clear, regular updates.
Give every candidate a great experience — fast, honest communication and a well-run process from first message to offer.
Keep our data clean and useful: accurate ATS hygiene, reliable reporting on funnel and sourcing performance, and insight on what channels are actually working.
Contribute to how we source: test new tools, channels and outreach approaches, and share what you learn with the wider team.
What we look for
Experience sourcing and recruiting in-house or in agency, ideally within software, SaaS, or the Data and AI space.
Demonstrable outbound sourcing ability — you can talk us through how you find and engage hard-to-reach candidates, not just how you manage inbound applications.
Comfort recruiting technical, customer-facing profiles, or a clear track record of learning technical domains quickly.
Strong written communication and a genuine interest in candidate experience.
Comfortable working with data and using it to prioritise your time and influence decisions.
Highly organised, able to run several searches at once across multiple EMEA markets and time zones.
Curious, collaborative and keen to grow — you want feedback and you act on it.

Get to know our People team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Engineering Recruiting team, reporting into the Recruiting Manager, Engineering (UK). You’ll partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers across Backend, Frontend, Full Stack, iOS, and Android teams to build diverse, high-quality pipelines and shape our top-of-funnel talent strategy.

Sourcing & Pipeline Building
Proactively identify and engage top-tier engineering talent using creative sourcing techniques, LinkedIn Recruiter, Ashby, and developer communities.
Craft thoughtful, highly personalised outreach that authentically brings Deliveroo’s brand, engineering challenges, and culture to life.
Stakeholder Partnership
Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to define role requirements, refine target profiles, and align on hiring priorities across engineering functions.
Deliver seamless candidate handoffs to recruiters, ensuring an exceptional candidate experience from first contact to interview stage.
Market Insights & Strategy
Leverage data to track pipeline health, outreach engagement, and conversion metrics to continuously optimise sourcing strategies.
Map relevant target companies and provide real-time talent market insights, mapping, and salary benchmarks to key stakeholders.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Drive DE&I initiatives by proactively sourcing candidates from underrepresented backgrounds and embedding inclusive sourcing practices across all searches.
What You’ll Need to Thrive

Proven experience sourcing technical talent (e.g., Backend, Frontend, Mobile) in-house or within a fast-paced tech recruitment agency.
Strong research and candidate engagement skills using advanced boolean search techniques and platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of building collaborative partnerships with recruiters and hiring managers.
Proactive, data-informed approach with a clear understanding of how sourcing metrics drive talent strategy and decision-making.
Passion for fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion, with demonstrated experience embedding DE&I principles into sourcing pipelines.

Hands-on experience working with modern applicant tracking systems such as Ashby.
Familiarity with engineering skill sets and domain landscapes across product and tech ecosystems.

The Opportunity
We’re looking for an exceptional Principal Recruiter to become our first Talent Acquisition partner based on the ground in Singapore. This is a senior individual contributor role, you will partner closely with our APJ General Manager and senior leadership team, leading critical hiring across the region.

Your primary focus will be Go-to-Market, owning searches across all levels, from individual contributors through to senior and executive hiring. As business priorities evolve, you’ll also support critical hiring across other functions and areas of the business.
This role goes beyond running an excellent recruiting process.
You’ll be a trusted talent advisor who understands the APJ market, can influence and challenge senior leaders, brings data and market intelligence to decisions, and remains exceptional at the craft of finding and engaging great talent.
You’ll be our first recruiter in Singapore, but you won’t be building alone. You’ll be part of an established APJ and global Talent Acquisition team, with the opportunity to shape how we recruit and compete for talent across the region. The position reports into the Senior Director, EMEA, APJ GTM based in the UK.

Partner with APJ leadership. Work directly with our APJ General Manager and senior leaders to translate business priorities into talent strategies and hiring outcomes.
Own critical hiring across APJ. Lead full-cycle searches across all levels, predominantly within Go-to-Market, while flexing into other priority functions and business areas as needs evolve.
Lead complex and senior searches. Personally own high-impact, senior and executive searches, including talent pipelining, from market mapping and engagement through assessment and close. Your scope of responsibility will include entry level through to senior searches dependent on business needs.
Build the market, not just the pipeline. Develop deep talent intelligence and networks across Singapore and APJ, identifying and engaging exceptional talent ahead of immediate hiring needs.
Bring insight and influence. Use market intelligence, data and recruiting expertise to challenge assumptions, shape decisions and help leaders understand where and how we can win for talent.
Raise the bar. Continually improve how we hire, removing friction, increasing quality and moving with urgency while partnering closely with our APJ and global teams.

Significant hands-on recruiting experience within a high-growth technology or SaaS environment, with deep knowledge of GTM talent across APJ and the Singapore market .
Passion for technology and a technical aptitude to be able to clearly articulate the opportunity we have.
Ability to be present in our SG office 2-3 days per week to collaborate with leadership, meet candidates and enjoy time with colleagues.
Experience owning full-cycle hiring across multiple levels, alongside a strong track record of personally delivering complex senior and executive searches.
Experience partnering directly with senior executives, including regional GMs, VPs and functional leaders.
Exceptional sourcing, talent mapping and market intelligence capability, with the ability to build and engage talent pools proactively.
The confidence and judgement to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders, backed by data, market insight and recruiting expertise.
The versatility to move across functions and talent profiles as business priorities change.

What we do
RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 600+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain.

Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t spoil in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.
We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters, and growth is still accelerating. The first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

You own end-to-end recruiting for a designated set of Technology & Product teams (R&D, as we call it internally), operating as a strategic partner to the leaders you support. The job isn't just filling requisitions; it's raising the quality of every hiring decision made across those teams. Your area is clearly defined, but not a boundary: we work as one TA team, so you'll be expected to support colleagues on other areas and pick up wider TA work when priorities shift.
This is an AI-native role. You're expected to orchestrate AI across the recruiting lifecycle (sourcing, screening, deliverables, quality checks) and build the systems that make that possible.
It reports to the Head of Talent Acquisition, R&D. The role is ideally based in Finland, Sweden, or the UK, and the remit is global. Prior experience hiring into the US market isn't a requirement, but it's a big plus, as is a flexibility to work across those time zones if needed.

Own the full recruiting cycle for your Technology & Product teams, from role scoping to offer acceptance: delivering personally where it counts and drawing on TA colleagues and our RPO and consultancy partners where that gets a better result. You own the outcome either way, including the quality bar.
Build sourcing pipelines so key roles have engaged candidates before the urgency hits, and sell RELEX credibly to senior, passive candidates, closing offers in competitive markets.
Coach hiring managers on role definition, interview design, and selection, and how candidates are assessed: on evidence, through a process you keep sharpening.
Deliver market intelligence (talent availability, comp benchmarks, funnel metrics) and spot upcoming hiring needs early, so they're in the plan before they become urgent.
Design and run AI-native recruiting workflows, piloting new approaches and updating the standard based on evidence.
Work in collaboration with our colleagues, in eg. People Business Partner, Compensation, People Operations, and Employer Branding teams, connecting hiring to the wider employee lifecycle.
Take named ownership of initiatives that reach beyond your own teams, such as assessment frameworks, interview standards, AI workflows and drive them to global adoption, working through the wider TA team, People Business Partners, Compensation, and People Operations to make them stick.

s.h: What you'll bring to the table
s.t:
Business acumen and stakeholder influence. You understand how engineering and product organisations work and build credibility with their leaders, operating effectively across a global organization.
Full-cycle recruiting delivery. You've managed complex, niche, senior hires under time pressure without losing the quality bar, delivering directly, or alongside TA colleagues and delivery partners.
Proactive, global sourcing and talent attraction. You market-map and source actively across platforms and geographies instead of waiting for inbound, and you close senior hires against competing offers.
Hiring manager coaching and assessment quality. You guide hiring managers through scoping and calibration, and you challenge requirements when the evidence points elsewhere.
Data literacy and market insight. You use pipeline and funnel metrics to show hiring health and your own impact, and you present that comfortably to senior stakeholders.
AI orchestration and process improvement. You already work AI-first rather than doing recruiting tasks by hand, and you bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for someone else to define it. You're equally comfortable stepping outside your own remit when the team needs it, and you've owned work at a broader scope than your own patch.

You've designed something, driven it to adoption, and made it work for other people, in collaboration with TA colleagues, People Business Partners, Compensation, and People Operations.

Ownership of hiring outcomes for some of RELEX's most important Technology & Product teams, with real input into how that hiring gets done.
The chance to recruit for a company where AI sits at the core of the product and the way we work, not at the edges.
A financially robust company still growing fast, with the scale and stability to back the hiring you'll be driving.
Flexibility in how and where you work, and practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life.
Two paid volunteering days a year to spend on causes you care about.
You'll need to be fluent in English.

s.h: ABOUT PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ROCKET LAB
s.t:
Rocket Lab’s People & Culture team is responsible for looking after our most valuable asset : our people . Across our global teams , the People & Culture team supports our people and departments across recruitment , new staff orientation , compensation , training and development .

They make sure our growing and diverse global team is supported and capable of delivering our projects and customer’s missions , and they’re responsible for supporting their development , nurturing their skills and talent , and retaining the world-class people already on our team .

We’re building a newly formed, high‑performing Talent Acquisition team, pushing boundaries, raising the bar, and redefining recruitment at Rocket Lab. We work fast, trust each other, and deliver. To match our pace and ambition, we’re hiring a Talent Acquisition Partner with proven ability to recruit world‑class technical engineering and aerospace talent.
You’ll operate in a highly technical, fast‑moving environment, partnering with hiring managers who rely on your guidance and expertise to navigate complex engineering requirements. Proven technical engineering or aerospace recruitment experience is essential, the complexity and speed of the work demand it.
You’ll influence hiring decisions, advocate for exceptional candidates, manage shifting priorities, and maintain momentum. This role demands the Rocket Lab hustle: moving fast, solving creatively, adapting instantly, and delivering when it matters most.

5+ years of recruitment experience
Proven technical engineering or aerospace recruitment experience, essential
Success sourcing hard‑to‑find technical talent through multiple channels
Experience from either agency or in‑house recruitment
Strong relationship building, hiring managers and candidates trust you because you deliver

A collaborative mindset, you thrive in a high‑trust, high‑performing team
The Rocket Lab hustle, urgency, resilience, and a drive for results

s.h: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING
s.t:
You don’t go to Mars working eight to five, Monday to Friday. The lights are always on at Rocket Lab because the work we do matters. When a launch window opens, we go. When a customer needs us, we deliver. When the mission calls, we answer.
This isn’t a role for someone seeking to coast. It’s for someone who wants their work to matter, someone who understands that hiring world‑class technical talent is how we achieve the impossible.

The challenge of recruiting for one of the most innovative companies in aerospace
A team that values your expertise, trusts you deeply, and has your back
The satisfaction of knowing every hire contributes to mission
If you thrive under pressure, love the hunt for exceptional technical talent, and want to work on missions that genuinely matter, let’s talk.
Please be aware that this role is fully office‑based, Monday to Friday, with no flexible or remote work arrangements.
If the above sounds like you apply now!
