It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace.

s.h: TALENT ACQUISITION PARTNER II / SENIOR - CONTRACT
s.t:
Based onsite at Rocket Lab’s Middle River, MD facility, the Talent Acquisition Partner is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with hiring managers and candidates alike to fill highly critical roles.
This is a full life-cycle recruitment position – you will own everything from initial sourcing and screening to extending offers. As a member of the TA team, you will be integral in fulfilling our mission to open up access to space to improve life on earth by hiring innovators who will help shape our rapidly expanding programs.
*This is a 6-month fixed-term role for immediate hire, with the potential opportunity to convert to full-time employment upon term completion. This role sits onsite at our Middle River, MD facility – remote work is not considered for this position.*

Serve as a strategic hiring expert and partner to hiring managers and business unit leaders
Partner with hiring managers to determine the requirements and expectations for their open positions, and the qualities of their ideal candidate
Manage the full hiring life-cycle, from initial sourcing and screening to extending offers
Screen candidates for open roles and guide them through the interview process
Build a diverse pipeline of talent, including passive candidates, through sourcing, cold calling, phone screens, and networking
Utilize our ATS (Greenhouse) to build reports and analyze key metrics on recruiting activities to drive process improvements
Travel as needed to support hiring efforts at other sites, including Launch Complex 3 in Wallops Island VA and Space Structures Complex in Middle River, MD

s.h: YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A TA PARTNER II
s.t:
Bachelor’s degree
2+ years of full-time, full-cycle recruiting experience

s.h: YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR TA PARTNER I
s.t:
Bachelor’s degree

s.h: 8+ years of full-time recruiting experience preferred
s.t:
Agency and in-house recruiting experience
Experience recruiting for high-volume nonexempt roles and/or engineering roles such as: production, manufacturing, test, mechanical, electrical, systems, propulsion, etc.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment supporting high-performing teams
Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with hiring managers at all levels, as well as candidates and external partners
Previous experience sourcing for highly technical and niche roles
This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.
Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab.

Employees may also receive company equity and access to a robust benefits package including: top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored medical HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, 3 weeks paid vacation and 5 days sick leave per year, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Other perks include: discounted employee stock purchase program, and free snacks/drinks onsite.
Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace.

We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

s.h: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY
s.t:
To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here .
Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com. This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

s.h: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY
s.t:
For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.
Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

At Samsara, we believe our people are our greatest investment, and hiring is a critical part of our success. We’re looking for a talented Recruiter to partner closely with our growing GTM teams to build a strong pipeline of top-tier candidates. This role is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow their career while helping scale high-performing teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Manage Full-Cycle Recruiting: Create and implement strategies to solve problems and build diverse pipelines across Samsara’s corporate teams through sourcing, referrals, research, events, and social media. Find and engage passive candidates through creative sourcing techniques and help them envision life at Samsara. Effectively manage multiple requisitions and candidates during high-volume periods while creating and owning a flawlessly positive candidate experience
Be a Talent Advisor: Partner closely with hiring leaders to deeply understand their teams and goals. Organize and facilitate interview debriefs and drive offer approval, extension, and negotiation. Identify closing strategies for offers and proactively provide candidates with the appropriate information to help make their decision as easy as possible
Influence with data: Independently address and unblock data analysis challenges. Extract and synthesize insights. Identify headwinds and tailwinds with a search.
Communicate Effectively: Tailor written and verbal communication to different audiences and situations.
Manage Stakeholders: Be seen as a trusted partner by other key cross-functional points of contact. Able to identify friction points, set appropriate expectations, and drive initiatives to overcome obstacles with a search.
Be a Diversity Advocate : Develop and implement sourcing strategies and marketing programs to identify top talent and build diverse candidate pipelines. Advise on structured interview processes that mitigate unconscious bias. Coach leaders and interviewers in inclusive interviewing best practices and objective feedback.
Process Excellence: Track pipeline data and provide relevant and consistent updates to hiring managers. Maintain high attention to detail when entering data into Greenhouse and other recruiting tools
Be a Cultural Champion: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

4+ years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment
Ability to create, measure, and scale the right workflow between candidates, hiring managers, and the recruiting team
Proven strategic sourcing skills
Team player with an eye for talent who loves connecting people and opportunities
Able to confidently represent Samsara with professionalism both internally and externally
Target-driven, detail-oriented, approachable, and able to bring up others around you
Previous tech experience preferred, and an unwavering ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Familiarity with Greenhouse or equivalent ATS experience
BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience

Working at Samsara has its perks: for all global employees, we provide private medical and dental insurance plus growth and development opportunities, as well as regular virtual team and company events. In the US we offer flexible vacation time, EMEA employees receive 25 vacation days plus national bank holidays. Post-COVID we’ll be back in our global offices with numerous in-office perks.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Recruiting team builds Stripe’s culture by connecting exceptional talent with our highest-impact business needs. We bring Stripe’s operating principles to life through thoughtful, consistent hiring practices, a high-quality candidate experience, and data-informed partnership with the business.

Stripe is looking for a consultative, creative recruiter to support critical Core Business functions. You will partner with senior leaders who shape Stripe’s financial strategy, external narrative, long-term growth, and company-wide decision-making.
This is a high-impact portfolio with varied talent markets, senior stakeholders, and roles where the quality of each hire can influence how Stripe operates and grows. You will own full-cycle recruiting, advise leaders on hiring strategy and market conditions, and build trusted relationships with candidates and hiring teams.

Partner with senior leaders to understand business priorities, define hiring plans, and develop recruiting strategies that support headcount goals.
Own the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake and sourcing through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.
Advise hiring teams on talent-market conditions, candidate availability, competitive dynamics, and hiring approaches for specialized and senior roles.
Develop and execute sourcing strategies that build broad, qualified candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Build strong candidate relationships and deliver a thoughtful, timely candidate experience throughout the process.
Use recruiting data to track progress, identify risks and opportunities, and provide clear updates to business leaders.
Improve recruiting processes where needed, testing practical changes that help hiring teams move with clarity and consistency.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal, to support a smooth offer and onboarding experience.
Uphold structured, competency-based hiring practices and help hiring teams assess candidates against the requirements of each role.

Experience developing sourcing strategies and engaging candidates for specialized or senior roles.
Ability to use recruiting data to identify trends, communicate progress, and improve recruiting outcomes.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple searches and shifting priorities.
A collaborative approach and comfort working across functions to solve problems and improve the hiring experience.
Curiosity about emerging AI tools and a practical approach to testing and adopting new ways of working.

Experience recruiting for business, corporate, finance, communications, strategy, legal, or other specialized professional functions.
Experience supporting senior-level hiring or roles with complex stakeholder groups.
Experience working across multiple geographies or advising on location strategy.
Familiarity with recruiting systems and sourcing tools, including applicant tracking systems, candidate relationship management tools, and LinkedIn Recruiter.

You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
Considering candidates living in East Coast timezone only.
We are looking for an Executive Recruiting Coordinator to join our US-based Talent Acquisition team and work exclusively on Executive and senior leadership hiring at Nebius.
This is not a traditional Recruiting Coordinator role. You will be the operational partner to our Executive Recruiters, supporting some of the most critical and high-profile searches across the company, including C-suite, VP and senior leadership roles within technology, AI and other strategic functions.
You will be responsible for ensuring that executive searches move seamlessly from initial engagement through interview, decision and offer.
Executive hiring at Nebius moves quickly and often involves multiple senior stakeholders, complex calendars, international time zones, confidential information, last minute changes and candidates who expect an exceptional level of service.
We are looking for someone who thrives in this environment, someone who is naturally proactive, exceptionally organised, calm under pressure and capable of operating several steps ahead of everyone else.
You won't simply be coordinating interviews. You will anticipate what the Executive Recruiter, candidate and hiring team will need next, identify risks before they become issues, and ensure every detail of the search is executed to an exceptionally high standard.

Manage multi-stage interview processes, aligning calendars across multiple time zones and senior stakeholders.
Coordinate interviews, candidate preparation calls, debriefs, feedback sessions and decision meetings.
Manage scheduling conflicts, last minute changes and search dependencies to keep processes moving.
Ensure interviewers and candidates have the information, interview plans and necessary materials required for each interaction.
Proficiency in Greenhouse, including managing interview stages and ensuring each search is configured and tracked according to its role-specific interview plan.
Proactively keep Executive Recruiters informed of coordination progress, outstanding actions and potential blockers.
Act as a trusted and highly responsive point of contact for senior and executive level candidates throughout the process.
Deliver a white glove polished, personalised and discreet candidate experience aligned with Nebius's executive hiring standards.
Coordinate candidate travel, accommodation and onsite experiences (as required.)
Partner with Executive Assistants and other support teams to ensure a seamless experience for candidates and senior stakeholders.
Act as a trusted operational partner to Executive Recruiters, enabling them to focus on search strategy, assessment and closing.
Build collaborative and trusted relationships with senior executives, hiring managers, Executive Assistants and other key stakeholders.
Take ownership of issues and drive solutions quickly with minimal disruption.
Handle sensitive executive searches with a high level of discretion, professionalism and attention to detail.

4+ years of experience in recruiting coordination in a high touch, high volume recruiting environment including at least 2 years of specialized experience supporting C-suite, VP or senior leadership hiring.
Experience working in an executive search firm, high-growth technology company or similarly fast-paced environment is highly desirable.
Experience coordinating multi-stage interview processes across multiple time zones.
Exceptional organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities without losing attention to detail.
Experience working directly with senior executives, Executive Assistants and/or senior hiring stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong professionalism and discretion.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.

Ability to build strong relationships and establish credibility with senior stakeholders.
Experience with ATS and recruiting operations platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or Workday Recruiting.
